header: You decide who to be, and the world reacts to your words and actions

origin.title: Say where you’re from
origin.text: Tell the taxi driver you’re from Spain, and he’ll tell you how his father came to America from Madrid in the 70s.
lines: Spain? My father came from Madrid…
origin.result: Learn something new about a person
origin.caption: The driver will say he has long wanted to see his father’s hometown but can’t because of work.
origin.alt: A taxi driver holding a coffee

leave.title: Leave without paying
leave.text: Slam the door without paying — and the owner will remember you. The evening may end at the police station: “I’m just practicing the language” is no excuse here.
lines: Hey! Come back! You haven’t paid!
leave.caption: Next time Sofia won’t serve you and will show you the door.
leave.alt: A café owner in an apron looking at you angrily

director.title: Become a film director
director.text: Tell the hotel receptionist you’re a famous director. She’ll greet you like a star and ask about your next film right away.
lines: No way! Are you going to blow up our hotel in your next movie?
director.result: A role changes how people treat you
director.caption: She’ll pitch you her idea for a film and ask for a role.

note: Language becomes the tool that moves the story forward.
